questions.q: What does an IPF logic condition consist of?
options: A mission line with a condition
The number of a logic rule in the mission list
A timer that starts the rule

questions.q: To write to GVAR 1, operand A must be…
questions.explain: The index is specified as a Value; “Global Variable 1” means the value stored in GVAR 1.

questions.q: When is it better to replace IPF with Lua/ArduPilot?
options: When there are dozens of rules
questions.explain: IPF is rules without loops or functions.

questions.q: Why can rules break after an INAV update?
options: All GVARs are reset on flashing
questions.explain: Check against the tables for your version.

questions.q: Override RC channel in IPF conflicts with:
options: The real stick on the same channel
PID and OSD at the same time
questions.explain: Better to use a virtual channel for modes.

questions.q: What is a Programming PID in INAV?
options: A configurable controller whose output is available to the logic
The rate-loop PID in the flight loop
PID autotune from Blackbox logs after a flight
A real-time ESC temperature controller based on DShot telemetry
questions.explain: Four programmable PID controllers; their output can be used in logic conditions.
